name: ccid-management-portal-root
description: Root configuration to run CCID portal

scripts.install: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install && cd ../court-frontend && npm install && cd ../court-backend && npm install && cd ../desktop && npm install
scripts.dev: npx concurrently "cd backend && node --watch server.js" "cd frontend && npm run dev" "cd court-frontend && npm run dev -- -p 3001" "cd court-backend && node --watch server.js"
scripts.desktop-dev: npx concurrently "npm run dev" "cd desktop && npm start"
scripts.desktop-build: cd frontend && npm run build && cd ../desktop && npm run dist
